name: Chat 🤖
description: On-device AI agent (Hermes-3 8B) that runs entirely in your browser
detailedDescription: Static-site LLM agent powered by WebLLM. The full model (Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B) runs on your GPU via WebGPU — no backend, no API key, no third-party LLM endpoint. Install once (~4.5 GB into your browser's OPFS cache); after that, chat is instant and works offline. Knows the HeymingOS app registry, can launch apps for you, and can read files in your virtual filesystem.

name: Audiobooks 🎧
detailedDescription: Stream thousands of free audiobooks from LibriVox's public-domain catalog. Chapter navigation, playback speed control, and Bluetooth/car media button support via the Web Media Session API. Resumes where you left off.

name: Books 📚
description: Free public-domain e-books from Project Gutenberg
detailedDescription: Read thousands of free public-domain books from Project Gutenberg via the Gutendex API. Adjustable font size and family, dark/sepia/light themes. Your reading position is saved automatically per book.

name: Checkboxes ☑️
description: One million shared checkboxes — click one and everyone sees it
detailedDescription: A scrolling grid of one million shared checkboxes. Click one and everyone else's page eventually sees it flip. Backed entirely by a Google Form (writes) and the linked Sheet (reads) — no server, no accounts. The page polls every few seconds, renders to canvas tiles for performance, and an Apps Script periodically compacts the response log into a packed-bitmap snapshot.

name: Trivia 🎯
description: Same three questions for everyone — new set every 30 minutes
detailedDescription: Global simultaneous trivia. Everyone on the site gets the same opinion, estimate, and fact prompts for a 30-minute window, then tallies and reveals roll over. Writes go through a Google Form; Round, Current, and Tallies are read from the linked Sheet via gviz. No accounts.

name: Posts 📝
description: Shared markdown + attachment posts — no accounts
detailedDescription: A bare-bones shared message board. Write markdown, add attachments, optionally leave a name, and make notes from creative apps across the site. Posts are written through a Google Form and read from the linked Sheet — no server, no accounts.

featured.headline: Leave a note
featured.blurb: A public sticky-note board for text, images, audio, drawings, and creations from apps across the site.

name: Paint 🎨

detailedDescription: MS Paint-inspired canvas app. Pencil, brush, shapes, flood fill, eyedropper, undo/redo — all in the browser.

name: Meme Generator 🖼️

detailedDescription: Browser-based Meme Generator clone. 30+ classic templates (Drake, Distracted Boyfriend, Two Buttons, etc.), upload your own image, draggable text boxes with Impact-font defaults, emoji stickers, background blur, and one-click PNG download or clipboard copy. Shareable URL captures the whole meme so a link reproduces it on any device. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

detailedDescription: Explore a Minecraft-inspired tree of achievements earned by playing games, creating things, and using apps across the site.
